policy.name: fail_closed_execution_source
policy.rule: classify the executable-selection route and its authority before any binary lookup, command construction, download, or process start; a route whose authority cannot be proven is refused, never silently executed
policy.authority_identity_separation: route authority is typed independently of canonical binary identity (#10340): identity proves what was selected, never that the selecting source was authorized

routes.host_behavior: current Zed consumes settings-binary overrides above the extension and gates them on its own worktree-trust boundary (crates/project/src/lsp_store.rs get_language_server_binary)
routes.extension_disposition: duplicate grant refused with a typed error naming the host mechanism and the remaining authorized routes; the refused value is never echoed

routes.surface: worktree.which("perllsp") over the worktree shell environment
limitations: no extension-checkable host trust fact exists for a PATH hit; retention rests on Zed's product-level worktree-environment model, not on an in-extension proof
direnv/shell/project hooks may alter PATH resolution and a project-controlled entry can shadow other candidates within this cell
this cell is visibly distinct from managed release identity: a PATH-selected binary never flows through the selection-manifest digest binding and is never presented as release-backed evidence

routes.surface: canonical EffortlessMetrics/perl-lsp release artifact selected by the offline-first startup route (#11308)
routes.identity_binding: #10340 binary identity + #10530 archive integrity + sha256 selection manifest

invariants: unknown or merged-away provenance cannot silently authorize execution
project/resource inputs cannot gain stronger execution authority merely through precedence

settings-supplied environment overrides cannot load code into the launched process: dynamic-loader injection keys (LD_PRELOAD/LD_AUDIT/LD_LIBRARY_PATH and DYLD_* counterparts) are dropped from the unproven override layer
structured path/argv identities only; no shell command string or interpolation is introduced
source authority and binary identity remain independently required
explicit, worktree-PATH, and managed routes remain separate support/evidence cells
missing Zed provenance narrows the candidate instead of weakening the policy
receipts and logs disclose route/authority without private values
